summary: New template versions never change your policies without your review.

new.title: Template updates you review first
new.text: A new Template updates tab lists what a newer template library adds, changes or removes. Changed templates show before and after, and how your policies differ.

new.title: Apply or skip persona changes
new.text: Persona changes from the library can be applied to your personas or skipped. Either way they are not offered again.

new.title: Your policies never change by themselves
new.text: Taking a template change only marks it as seen; your policies stay as they are. Every take needs Admin and a reason, and is audited.
